action and forgot the"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"DeepSeek Harness agent turn when the model only *narrated* its next
action and forgot the tool call."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The agent loop closes a turn as `completed` the moment a step emits text and no
tool call. A model t"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"hat writes "now I will re-apply the change" and stops looks
finished to the loop, even though the wo"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"I will re-apply the change" and stops looks
finished to the loop, even though the work is half done."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This plugin listens on `agent/turn-stopping`, replays the current turn's own
session log, and only a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"sks a judge model one strict `true`/`false` question
when the shape matches that failure mode. `true"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"` steers the same turn to run one
more step; `false` (or an unparseable answer) lets the turn close."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Install into a profile with the dsh CLI. Its `plugin` subcommand forwards to
pnpm inside the profile"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" directory, so `add`/`remove` behave as usual:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Then restart the profile. The profile's `package.json` gains the dependency and
`dsh.profile.bundles"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"` entry, and the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the
guard into the layer stack — no manual patch"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" editing is required."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"To remove it:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Working from a local checkout instead? Point the profile at the directory:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Source edits under `lib/` are picked up only on restart."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Config"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| field            | default | in card | meaning                                        |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| `maxContinuations` | 10    | yes     | hard cap on steering per turn (no infinite loop) |
| `maxSt"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"eps`       | 6       | yes     | newest steps shown to the judge                |
| `maxTailChars`  "},{"id":"p17s3","text":" | 1500    | yes     | trailing-text budget split across the first and last halves |
| `judgePrompt`"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"    | built-in | yes    | instruction telling the judge what counts as unfinished |
| `steerText`   "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"   | built-in | yes    | message injected when the guard steers        |
| `debug`          | false "},{"id":"p17s6","text":"  | yes     | log every evaluation (needs a restart)         |
| `judgeProvider`  | null    | no    "},{"id":"p17s7","text":"  | override provider; null/unset = derive from the session route |
| `judgeModel`     | null    | n"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"o      | override model; null/unset = derive from the session route    |
| `judgeMaxTokens` | 64    "},{"id":"p17s9","text":"  | no      | judge output cap                               |
| `judgeTemperature` | 0     | no    "},{"id":"p17s10","text":"  | judge sampling temperature                     |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Deterministic gates"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"No model call runs unless the turn *both*:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"1. ended on a text-only step (no tool call), and
2. called at least one tool earlier (so a plain one"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"-shot answer is untouched)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"This keeps the extra judge call off ordinary finished turns and only spends it
where the model plaus"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ibly dropped a pending action."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## The judge call is self-contained"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"What goes out for that one call is deliberately small and built from scratch:
`system` is `judgeProm"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"pt`, and `messages` is a single user message holding
`renderSummary(...)` — the trailing text plus t"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"he last `maxSteps` steps. No
`tools` are sent, and no session history is replayed. The test
`sends t"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"he judge a self-contained request` pins that shape."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**Reusing the session would be cheaper per token, and that is not the
question.** The host derives m"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"essages incrementally and reuses the frozen
message objects (`Session.deriveMessages`), so appending"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" one user turn leaves
the whole prefix byte-identical and the provider's prefix cache does hit. That"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"
part works. But the saving is the *miss* on roughly 1–2k tokens, and the
verdict is this plugin's e"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ntire output. Three properties are worth more than
that:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Determinism.** `temperature: 0` over a fixed summary answers the same way
for the same turn shap"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"e. A judge reading the whole conversation drifts with
it.
- **Focus.** The question is narrow — does"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" the trailing text promise an action
that no tool call performed. Trailing text plus the last few st"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"eps is the
signal; dozens of earlier turns dilute it.
- **Cost that tracks the turn, not the session"},{"id":"p25s5","text":".** The call is O(1–2k tokens)
whether the conversation is 3 steps or 300."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"If the goal is fewer tokens, shrink the input instead: lower `maxTailChars` or
`maxSteps`. That cuts"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" the call without giving up any of the three."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Stopping early"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Steering is not free: each continuation costs a judge round-trip plus one more
agent step. So the gu"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ard also watches whether a steer *worked*."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"When it steers, it records how far the session log had grown. The next time the
same turn stops, it "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"checks whether any assistant step in between actually called
a tool. If the model only narrated agai"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"n, the steer was ignored and the turn is
closed instead of spending the remaining budget on the same"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" refusal. A model
that answers the steer with a real tool call keeps its normal budget."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Configuring the guard"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The guard resolves its config on every evaluation rather than freezing it at
mount, so a change reac"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"hes the very next turn-stopping check. Two ways to set
values:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- the user settings file, `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`, under a `loop-continue:` key, or
- the profile's o"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"wn `cordis.patch.yml`."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Prefer leaving `judgeProvider`/`judgeModel` unset. The guard then judges with
the model the current "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"conversation is already running, which is by definition a
working route; set them only to judge with"},{"id":"p33s3","text":" a different model on purpose."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Editing the prompts"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Both prompt texts ship as defaults and are plain config fields, so you can
retune the guard without "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"touching code. The package ships a browser half, so
the editor is a card under **Settings > Plugins "},{"id":"p35s3","text":"> plugin config**. It starts
collapsed like every other plugin card; click the header to open it:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"The prompts save **on blur**, not per keystroke: the Host validates and
persists the whole document "},{"id":"p37s2","text":"on every write, and one write per keystroke of a
740-character policy paragraph is wasteful. The num"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"eric fields and the toggle
save immediately. Every change except `debug` applies to the next
turn-st"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"opping check with **no restart**; `debug` is read when the plugin is
loaded, so it needs one."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"The same fields are editable in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`, which is also the
surface to use when the pl"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"ugin runs headless with no browser half loaded:"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
